title: Full-Language Conformance Closure
acceptance_criteria: Every publicly claimed supported surface has machine-readable authority, stable status, and executable evidence for every applicable layer.
Every specified but unsupported surface is visibly classified and fails explicitly if syntax would otherwise be silently ignored.
Canonical IR contains every accepted semantic fact required by downstream supported tools.
Public support documentation is generated or drift-checked from conformance authority.
A full-language conformance run is deterministic in CI and yields a reviewable support-gap inventory.
